jobs.title: General Warehouse Associate
jobs.description:
Wise Staffing Group is NOW HIRING multiple Warehouse Associates in the West Chicago, IL area! Multiple shifts available!


Job Summary:

We are seeking a Warehouse Associate to join a fast-paced warehouse and distribution operation. This position supports inventory management, shipping, receiving, and order fulfillment. This role is responsible for performing hands-on warehouse duties, including picking, packing, sorting, material handling, and inventory activities.


Responsibilities:

  • Receive, inspect, store, pick, and pack products to support daily shipping and fulfillment operations.
  • Safely operate warehouse equipment to move materials throughout the facility.
  • Perform inventory counts and maintain accurate inventory records.
  • Pick and pack orders accurately and efficiently.
  • Assist with shipping and receiving activities as needed.
  • Load, unload, move, and organize materials throughout the warehouse.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Follow all company safety procedures and warehouse operating guidelines.
  • Perform a combination of equipment operation and manual warehouse tasks throughout the shift.


Qualifications:

  • Previous warehouse experience required.
  • Cherry picker experience preferred.
  • Ability to lift, carry, move, and handle materials throughout the shift.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced warehouse environment.
  • Ability to perform repetitive physical tasks while maintaining productivity and accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow instructions.
  • Reliable attendance and dependable work ethic.


Why Wise Staffing Group:

  • Weekly pay
  • Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, and Life insurance
  • Temp-to-hire opportunity


Benefits:

  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Vision insurance


Work Location: In person

Company Description

Headquartered in Tupelo, MS, Wise Staffing Group is a full-service human resources company specializing in temporary and career staffing with an emphasis on providing excellent customer service. Wise Staffing Group become one of the largest staffing services in the Southeast United States. Since 1987, we have proven to be one of the most respected providers of innovative staffing solutions. We have developed and offer industry leading services that provide dependable, qualified workers. Each office sets and maintains the same high standards of operation and ongoing commitment to quality services. We consistently work toward superior performance in fulfilling client needs.

jobs.title: Night Warehouse Manager
jobs.description:
Founded in 1991, Testa Produce, Inc. is the successor entity to the original Dominick Testa and Sons.Testa Produce's roots date back to 1912, with founder Dominick Testa selling stalks of celery door-to-door out of a basket. The creation of the Chicago Terminal Produce Market provided a central selling location for years. As the restaurant industry evolved, so did Testa Produce. In 2011, Testa expanded yet again and moved into its new home: a 91,300 square foot facility to accommodate an ever-growing list of restaurant, hotel and food service customers. 

Essential Functions: 

  • Direct and manage day-to-day PM warehouse functions, order selection, and staging using WMS and RF scanning systems.
  • Oversee night loading assignments, ensuring proper pallet building, weight distribution, and adherence to USDA stacking guidelines (e.g., separating conventional vs. organic products).
  • Ensure strict product rotation using FIFO criteria to optimize inventory flow, minimize damage, mis-picks, and product waste.
  • Support and collaborate with the PM Dispatch and Transportation teams on daily tasks, route staging, and system-shipping orders to ensure accurate, on-time departures.
  • Reconcile orders prior to shipment, audit loads for accuracy, and maintain warehouse organization for maximum shipping accessibility.
  • Enforce Good Warehouse Practices (GWPs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and strict food safety guidelines.
  • Inspect outbound vehicles and temperature-sensitive areas to prevent contamination and maintain strict cold-chain compliance.
  • Direct PM warehouse sanitation efforts to maintain a clean, safe, and orderly facility.
  • Lead and promote a strong safety culture in partnership with the Safety Department, conducting routine inspections, associate observations, and accident investigations to determine root cause.
  • Oversee material handling equipment (MHE) usage and maintenance, ensuring team members operate forklifts, pallet jacks, lift-gates, and ramps safely and correctly.
  • Ensure full compliance with company policies, food safety requirements, and OSHA/DOT standards.
  • Recruit, train, coach, and manage PM warehouse personnel, fostering high morale, top performance, and accountability.
  • Help maintain contingency protocols to eliminate business disruptions during night shifts.
  • Maintain, organize, written employee training, performance improvement guidance, and discipline records in coordination with Human Resources and General Counsel & CAO.

Competencies:

  • Start-Up Smart (willing to do what’s needed whenever and wherever needed)
  • Intellectual horsepower (highly analytical & strategic)
  • Highly resourceful (stretches people and money; compresses time)
  • Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills (high EQ)
  • Innovative and creative thinking (need fresh thinking)
  • Listening skills (listen first, then respond)
  • Complex problem-solving skills (create options, then coverage)
  • Organized and attention-to-detail approach (strong tactical execution)

Education, and Experience:

  • High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelor's degree in business administration, supply chain, logistics, management, or a related equivalent preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in a warehouse or distribution environment, with at least 1- 2 year’s experience in a supervisory/management role.
  • Experience in food, produce, grocery, or perishable-goods distribution strongly preferred.
  • Proficient PC skills in CRM and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems- Produce Pro, Microsoft Office (particularly Excel), and common E Mail systems.
  • Must be able to read, speak, and write English satisfactorily, bilingual a plus.

Compensation:

  • $ 85,000 - $100,000/Year (Based on experience)

Schedule: 

  • Sunday – Friday (Off on Saturdays)
  • Start Time: 6:00pm

Physical Demands:

  • Work in cold and wet cooler conditions for extended periods of time
  • Stand, walk, or sit for long periods of time
  • Occasionally lift up to 50lbs

Benefits:

  • Health & Welfare Benefits – 90 days of employment
  • Medical & Dental (75%/25%)
  • Paid Time Off
  • Holidays
  • 401(k) with 4% Company Match – eligible after 1 year of employment
  • Weekly Paid
  • Career Advancement Opportunities
  • Employee Purchase Program
  • On-site Employee Unleaded Fuel Program

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws and ordinances.

jobs.title: Warehouse Supervisor
jobs.description:
Warehouse Supervisor

The Warehouse Supervisor will lead warehouse, receiving, and inventory operations in a manufacturing environment. This role oversees material flow, inventory accuracy, receiving activities,

and a team of warehouse professionals to ensure production runs efficiently and safely.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, train, and support a team of warehouse employees.

  • Oversee daily receiving, inventory control, and stockroom operations.

  • Maintain inventory accuracy through cycle counts and material organization.

  • Manage material replenishment, Kanban programs, and production floor stock.

  • Coordinate inbound shipments, material inspections, and inventory transactions within the ERP system.

  • Ensure compliance with safety policies, PPE requirements, and material-handling procedures.

  • Investigate inventory discrepancies and enforce FIFO inventory practices.

  • Support intercompany transfers and identify process improvement opportunities.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of warehouse, inventory, or stockroom experience.

  • 2+ years of supervisory or leadership experience.

  • Experience with ERP systems

  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

  • Forklift and other material handling equipment experience preferred.

Salary Range: $65,000-$75,000

Benefits:

  • Health, dental, and vision, life, short/long term disability insurance

  • 401(k) offering

  • Paid time off and holidays (80 hours PTO)

  • Paid sick leave where applicable by state law.

jobs.description:
About the position

This is a part-time position in Chicago, IL, focusing on supporting fresh product operations within a warehouse environment. The role involves processing inbound and outbound products, managing inventory, and ensuring product quality for customer orders. The position requires attention to detail, the ability to use various equipment, and collaboration with other teams.

Responsibilities

  • Processing of in-bound product
  • Enter information into inventory control system.
  • Process invoices
  • Prepare product for customer orders.
  • Process pick-up orders.
  • Ensure quality of product for customer orders.
  • Communicate product availability to salespeople.
  • Interact with incoming delivery drivers.
  • Coordinate with other work centers.
  • Assist with receiving deliveries.
  • Inform management of any problems or concerns.
  • Straighten boxes, sweep floors, process recycling, remove trash as needed
  • Rotate stock as directed.
  • Follow safety guidelines
  • Additional projects as assigned by leadership.

Requirements

  • At least two years of retail, logistics, or warehouse experience required.
  • Able to collaborate and communicate with other work teams.
  • Detail oriented for processing customer orders.
  • Able to use powered and manual equipment, cutting tools, and other tools.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.
  • Prolonged periods standing on cement flooring.
  • Ability to lift 25 pounds, 50 pounds on occasion, and 80 pounds as a team lift.
  • Able to work in coolers.

At IPG, we are more than just a global leader in packaging and protective solutions—we are a community that values safety, people, passion, integrity, performance, and teamwork. From tapes and films to packaging and protective products, as well as engineered coated materials and advanced packaging machinery, we develop innovative solutions that protect the world. Now, we are expanding our global team and looking for talented individuals like you!

Position Description

Title: Packer

Department: Operations

ImmediateSupervisor: Plant Supervisory Staff

Status: Hourly

Position Purpose: Packs boxes and prepares product for shipment

Principle Accountabilities

  • Removes finished products from the machine, places product labels, packs item in bags and cartons, and places finished product in proper location as per specifications.
  • Performs advanced quality checks, and effectively communicates with operator and supervisor to ensure that finished products are made to required quality specifications.
  • Aids in the proper and effective operation of the machinery.
  • Willing to assist in other areas of the plant, including to cover lunches and breaks as required.
  • Performs all work in a safety first mentality and with utilization of IPS lean manufacturing skills.
  • Related tasks as requested by supervisor

Essential Skills And Experience

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent preferred.
  • Intermediate math skills and English written communication skills necessary.
  • Ability to stand and walk for up to 12 hours at a time required
  • Ability to work in space limited work area on continuous basis.
  • Ability to lift and maneuver up to 50 lbs on a consistent basis

Why Choose IPG?

At IPG, you will find more than just a job—you will find a place where your success is our success. We pride ourselves on a culture built around strong relationships, where every team member plays a crucial role in our growth. Whether it is through cross-department collaboration, continuous training, or sustainability-driven initiatives, we create an environment where you can thrive.

Our commitment to sustainability influences everything we do, from designing eco-friendly products to minimizing waste in our production processes. We are dedicated to building a greener future while providing safe, supportive workplaces for our people.

With over 40 years of industry expertise and a proven track record of growth and innovation, IPG offers a stable, secure environment where you can flourish!

We offer competitive pay, extensive benefits that support you and your family, and exciting career development opportunities. Whether you are looking to enhance your skills or advance your career, we offer ongoing training and the support you need to succeed. Think big, dream bigger, and make an impact with IPG.

You belong here. Join us today!

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate, Operations
jobs.description:
Chowbus is a leading Asian restaurant technology SaaS platform, with deep roots in the North American market for years. Currently, we stand as a pioneering enterprise in the North American Asian Restaurant SaaS sector. Driven by precise market positioning and efficient product services, our business has achieved doubled growth annually, covering over 30 core states and 100 key cities across the U.S., and partnering with more than 10,000 Asian restaurants. We build tech ecosystems that help restaurants grow, serve with heart, and uplift their communities. Our vision is to create a world where culturally rooted food entrepreneurs thrive everywhere.

The Warehouse Operations Associate role plays a key role in driving our operational efforts in the Restaurant Technology business. The role works on site at our HQ warehouse, and manages inbound/outbound shipments, inventory management, and coordinates with our 20+ cities to drive best practices in logistics, ensuring a world class post-sales experience for our merchants.

What You'll Focus On

  • Shipping (picking, packing, fulfilling orders using WMS and multiple shipping softwares)
  • Receiving (cycle counting, accepting, checking, and recording incoming goods from suppliers before storing them)
  • Pre-setting equipment before it is stocked into inventory
  • Maintaining a clean and organized warehouse by ensuring stations are reset to specifications, disposing of garbage and recycling, and returning inventory to its designated locations at the end of the day
  • Handle materials with care to prevent damage and ensure safety within the warehouse environment
  • Creating RMA labels and checking returned equipment back into inventory
  • Communicate with different departments regarding shipping orders and receiving RMAs


What You Bring

  • 0–3 years of warehouse or operational experience, including fulfillment, picking, packing, labeling, cycle counting, and operating pallet jacks or electric pallet jacks. Forklift experience is not required.
  • Bilingual proficiency in English and Mandarin preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field preferred
  • Familiarity with the Google interface preferred
  • Strong organizational and project management skills required
  • Ability to manage time and prioritize effectively required
  • Ability to communicate clearly with different stakeholders required
  • Ability to learn technical aspects of POS related hardware and software required
  • Flexibility to learn new systems
  • Ability to effectively multitask and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced daily work environment
  • Experience using inventory management systems to track, manage, and maintain accurate inventory records
  • Strong teamwork and the ability to work well with others are essential
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and organization
  • Familiarity with Salesforce is a plus


Work Condition

  • Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods throughout the workday.
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday.
  • Ability to regularly lift, move, and carry equipment weighing up to 50 lbs as part of the job.
  • This is an on-site position located in the Chicago Chinatown area.


What We Offer

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k)
  • 100% employer-paid Short-Term Disability (STD)
  • 100% employer-paid Life Insurance and option for additional employee-paid Life Insurance
  • 100% employer-paid Accidental Death and Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance and option for additional employee-paid AD&D Insurance
  • Company holidays
  • Birthday off
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Hourly pay is $20 to $23
